# creating Geommap in R for two continent sampling strategy for CyanoHAB
first of i need multiple packages to build the map
Library (ggplot2), even though we are making the geom map in the R but we still need the basic packages 
library ( library ggrepel), it prevents label and text from overalping from each other 
library(dplyr) # it's basic package for calculation i guess this one is present in the umbrella of tidyverse
library(sf), # this handles representation, manipulation and analysis of spatial vector data in R - we are mainly using st_transform() - which to transform coordinate system , we are also gonna use the geom_sf() in the ggplot to plot map easily and create layers from the data we get from the rnaturalearth and our own personalised data 
library(rnaturalearth), # it's a public domaine set of world map and geospatial datasets 
now the codes start
first of we are getting the world map data from ne_ coutnries function which is present in rnaturalearth 
world<-ne_countries(scale="medium", returnclass="sf") # why do we keep the scale and returnclass like this this is more like a factory setting as it strikes a perfect balance between computer performance and coding copatibility
there three scales present- medium is a sweet spot to be in 
retunclass =sf as R uses old package sp, to manage spatial data and we want it to be simple features data as it will act like a normal or regular data set 
we are gonna use pipeline function a lot in this coding, which is present in dplyr package 
next code we are filtering the whole world map to only two continent which is Europe and North America gonn
a save it to Filter_world
Filterworld<-world%>%filter(continent%in%c("Europe", "North America")
we want Mollweide projection in our map - which mainly use to display global distributions , thematic data and any visualization where we need to show correct proportional size of landmasses , here target_crs - a user define variable name storing the projection string so it can be passed into spatial transformation functions 
target_crs<-"+proj=moll"
next i wanna see the changes i have made so far in the open data which filtered and saved it as filterworld 
plot
